title: Fixed Pivoted Slot Lever and Guided Ram Display
description: One wholly newly authored fixed pivoted-slot lever and guided-ram teaching display. A common finite ground bed supports a low fixed lever pivot, an independent rear crank-disc shaft and two full upper ram-guide posts. One complete long thick lever contains a genuine bounded longitudinal slot and pivots visually at its lower end; a separate fixed rectangular block in that slot receives the rear disc eccentric pin. At the upper lever end a whole independent connecting link reaches a separate horizontal ram through two genuinely bored guide sleeves. This topology is not the old directly translated vertical-slot yoke with integral stems, nor the cylinder/piston-crosshead bench: lower fixed lever pivot and upper second link are explicit parts of this complete arrangement. All coordinates and meshes new, three opaque PBR roles, metres Z up, one model zero scenes. Static artistic pose only; fixed pin overlaps and clearances do not validate kinematics. No quick-return ratio, straight-line trajectory, full travel, sliding or rotation, motion solution, timing, torque, force, transmission, processing, manufacture or machinery safety capability. Rigging animation interaction not made.
